products.name: Pembersih Lantai
products.usage: Membersihkan & mewangikan lantai keramik, granit, marmer, dan vinyl. Encerkan sebelum dipakai.
products.usageEn: Cleans and freshens ceramic, granite, marble and vinyl floors. Dilute before use.

products.name: Pembersih Kamar Mandi & Kerak
products.usage: Mengangkat kerak, noda kapur, dan karat pada kloset, wastafel, shower, dan keramik kamar mandi.
products.usageEn: Removes limescale, stains and rust from toilets, basins, showers and bathroom tiles.

products.name: Pembersih Kaca & Cermin
products.usage: Kaca jendela, cermin, dan etalase bening tanpa bekas garis.
products.usageEn: Streak-free windows, mirrors and display glass.

products.name: Degreaser Dapur
products.usage: Melarutkan minyak dan lemak membandel di kompor, hood, wajan, dan dapur komersial.
products.usageEn: Cuts heavy grease on stoves, hoods, pans and commercial kitchens.

products.name: Disinfektan & Sanitizer
products.usage: Membasmi kuman pada permukaan, gagang pintu, meja, dan area umum.
products.usageEn: Kills germs on surfaces, door handles, tables and public areas.

products.name: Sabun Cuci Tangan
products.usage: Sabun cair lembut untuk dispenser toilet, dapur, dan kamar tamu.
products.usageEn: Gentle liquid soap for toilet, kitchen and guest-room dispensers.

products.name: Deterjen Laundry Cair
products.usage: Mencuci linen, handuk, dan seragam; efektif untuk mesin cuci maupun manual.
products.usageEn: Washes linen, towels and uniforms; works in machines or by hand.

products.name: Pengharum Ruangan
products.usage: Aroma segar tahan lama untuk kamar, lobi, dan toilet.
products.usageEn: Long-lasting fresh scent for rooms, lobbies and toilets.
